mentions.name: Grain of Salt
mentions.description: A graph-based recipe app for storing and converting recipes. Planned graph features include linking two users' recipe trees when recipes were imported via the same URL, while deliberately avoiding cool-sounding features that don't add functionality. Also planned are recipe-app staples such as nested recipes, temperature conversions, and converting volumetric ingredient amounts to mass. It is being used for new recipes and for converting old handwritten recipes, and has been usable in its early stages.
